knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Lucy Connolly posted a tweet calling for mass deportation and for hotels housing asylum seekers to be set on fire.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Lucy Connolly, then 41, a childminder, and the wife of a Conservative West Northamptonshire Councillor, posted a tweet calling for "[m]ass deportation now" and for hotels housing asylum seekers to be set on fire

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Tyler James Kay was sentenced to 38 months in prison for copying Lucy Connolly's posts.
knowledge_cards.source_span: On 9 August 2024, a 26-year old man, Tyler James Kay, was sentenced to 38 months (to serve up to half) for copying Connolly's posts.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Ricky Jones was filmed addressing a crowd at a counter-protest in Walthamstow, stating that fascists' throats should be cut.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Ricky Jones, a Dartford Labour councillor, was filmed addressing a crowd at a counter-protest in Walthamstow, East London, stating: "They are disgusting fascists and we need to cut all their throats and get rid of them all."

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Andrew McIntyre was jailed for seven and a half years for his role in instigating violence via a Telegram group.
knowledge_cards.source_span: Andrew McIntyre, a 39-year-old taxi driver, who started the group was jailed for seven and a half years in January 2025 for his role in instigating violence.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Charles-Emmanuel Mikko Rasanen was an administrator in the "Southport Wake Up" Telegram messaging group who shared online instructions on how to commit arson.
knowledge_cards.source_span: revealed him to be Charles-Emmanuel Mikko Rasanen, a neo-Nazi from Helsinki, Finland who shared online instructions on how to commit arson with the UK rioters.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: The 2024 United Kingdom race riots began in Southport.

knowledge_cards.source_span: On 2 August, rioting took place in Sunderland, where a Citizens Advice bureau was set on fire and police officers were injured and several people were arrested.

knowledge_cards.fact_statement: Rioting occurred outside a Holiday Inn Express hotel in Rotherham.
knowledge_cards.source_span: In Wath upon Dearne in the Metropolitan Borough of Rotherham, there were demonstrations by anti-immigration and anti-racism protesters, with the former outnumbering the latter. There was then rioting outside a Holiday Inn Express hotel
